senses.gloss: f.(b. h. = חתתית; חָתַת)being broken, subdued; esp. dread inspired by superiors, fear.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 9:2">Gen. IX, 2</cite>, compared with I, 28) <he>מורא וח׳ חזרו</he> (not <he>וחתות</he>) the fear and dread (of man) were restored (after the deluge), but subjection was not.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17a:4">R. Hash. 17ᵃ</cite> (applying <cite ref="Ezekiel 32:24">Ez. XXXII, 24</cite> sq.) <he>שנתנו חִיתִּיתָם וכ׳</he> those (leaders) who tyrannize the land of the living.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5">Koh. R. to XII, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>חתחתים</he>, <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:5">ib.</cite>) [read:] <he>חִיתִּיתָהּ של דרך וכ׳</he> the dread of travelling befalls him.
